dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, Ryan and I are going to the night market this evening.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ˈraɪən ənd aɪ ər ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ðə ˈnaɪt ˌmɑːrkɪt ˈðɪs ˈiːvnɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Have fun! But keep an eye on your bag. There are pickpockets there.
dialogue.reading: ˈhæv ˈfʌn! bʌt ˈkiːp ən ˈaɪ ɑːn jʊr ˈbæɡ. ðɛr ər ˈpɪkpɑːkɪts ˈðɛr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No. Take a photo of it on your phone in case you need it.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ. ˈteɪk ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ɪt ɑːn jʊr ˈfoʊn ɪn ˈkeɪs juː ˈniːd ɪt.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Good idea. And I'll take some extra cash in case I lose my card.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. ənd aɪl ˈteɪk sʌm ˈɛkstrə ˈkæʃ ɪn ˈkeɪs aɪ ˈluːz maɪ ˈkɑːrd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Is the market safe at night?
dialogue.reading: ɪz ðə ˈmɑːrkɪt ˈseɪf ət ˈnaɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mostly. There are security guards, and there's CCTV everywhere.
dialogue.reading: ˈmoʊstli. ðɛr ər sɪˈkjʊrəti ˌɡɑːrdz, ənd ðɛrz ˌsiː siː tiː ˈviː ˈɛvriwɛr.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What should I do if I see someone suspicious?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ʃʊd aɪ ˈduː ɪf aɪ ˈsiː ˈsʌmwʌn səˈspɪʃəs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Tell a guard or call the police. Save the number on your phone in case something happens.
dialogue.reading: ˈtɛl ə ˈɡɑːrd ɔːr ˈkɔːl ðə pəˈliːs. ˈseɪv ðə ˈnʌmbər ɑːn jʊr ˈfoʊn ɪn ˈkeɪs ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈhæpənz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I just want you to be safe!
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈdʒʌst ˈwɑːnt juː tə bi ˈseɪf!
